brief:
Palestinians with missing relatives are marking International Day of Remembrance and Tribute to Victims of Terrorism, according to Al Jazeera English. The commemorations reflect a sustained effort by victims' families to pursue accountability for attacks by Israeli settlers, many of which have left relatives unaccounted for.

The day of remembrance has become a focal point for Palestinians documenting cases of missing persons and casualties attributed to settler violence. Families continue pressing for investigations and legal remedies as they navigate obstacles in pursuing their claims through available channels. Many cases remain unresolved despite years of advocacy and documentation by rights groups and affected communities.
dek: Palestinians with missing relatives are marking International Day of Remembrance and Tribute to Victims of Terrorism.
title: Palestinians seek justice for missing relatives in settler attacks
